City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
OCTOBER 14, 2021 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.

2.

U.S. Pledge-Of-Allegiance

CHANGES TO THE AGENDA (Announce Administrative Changes to the Agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.)

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.

Draft Ordinance 2021-15 (Mandatory Organics Recycling and Edible Food Recovery Ordinance). Ashlee Stratakis, Management Analyst.
1.
Consider and provide input on draft Ordinance 2021-15 introducing Chapter 11.23 - Mandatory Organics Recycling and Edible Food Recovery, draft Ordinance 2021-16 amending Chapter - 11.22 Solid Waste Management, and draft Ordinance 2021-17 amending Chapter 11.23 - Construction and Demolition Debris Recycling.
2.
Approve a recommendation to City Council to Introduce and Adopt Ordinance(s) 2021-15, 2021-16, and 2021-17.
